findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Security
Case: normal use - a task review reports a false positive on a demo handler and a P0 authorization flaw on a different handler in the same file, using the same title. A coordinator dismisses the demo note citing its unchanged line; `_settled` still keys dismissals by file and title (`src/forge/review.py:640`), and this change bypasses only `known:` settlements. The repair review's P0 therefore receives the demo dismissal and is omitted from blocking findings and the worker brief. The same collision can discard a finding as previously fixed at `src/forge/review.py:1036`; `src/forge/close.py:396` can also apply a requested dismissal to the first same-title finding rather than the selected one. Settlements and dismissals need to distinguish the finding's line or body, as the coordinator required.
